# Bring the Broken Toaster. Stay for Coffee.
## Fix-It Saturday at St. Ansgar — everyone welcome

**Saturday, December 5, 2026 · 9 a.m.–1 p.m.**  
**Fellowship Hall, St. Ansgar Lutheran Church · Minneapolis, MN**  
**Enter through the alley door, where there’s a ramp.**

A few months ago, Marv Okafor fixed my 1970s Hamilton Beach mixer in twenty minutes in the church kitchen. That’s where this idea began. Too much gets thrown away when all it needs is a screw, a new cord, or somebody who knows where to look.

Our church council approved Fix-It Saturday last week, and I confess I’m thrilled. On December 5, we’re opening Fellowship Hall to the whole neighborhood for a morning of fixing things and visiting over coffee.

Our volunteer fixers so far can help with:

- Small appliances and lamps
- Bikes
- Clothing mending
- Knife sharpening
- Laptops and phones, with help from a retired tech fellow

Doris Lindqvist, 84, who has darned socks for this parish since the Carter years, asked to run the mending table herself. I know better than to stand in her way.

**It’s free. No church membership, no sign-up, and no strings attached.** Nobody will preach at you. Donations to the food shelf are welcome but not expected. We can’t promise every item can be repaired, but we’ll give it a careful look. Please bring **one item per person to start**, so we can keep the line moving.

Coffee and kringle will be provided. Bring the broken toaster—and stay for coffee. This is good neighboring, plain and simple.

After December, we’ll meet on the **first Saturday of every month through spring**.

**Can you help fix things?** We’d love a few more volunteer fixers, especially anyone who knows vacuums or zippers. To volunteer or ask a question, contact the church office at **office@stansgarlutheran.example** or **612-555-0148**.
